# Deckhouse — Kinetic & Avant-Garde Presentation Archive (LLM & Agent Guide)

> Status: Early Experimental Build (`v0.2-dev`). Verify outputs with `python studio_engine/ai_slide_director.py audit <file.pptx>` or inspect live slide strips on the site.

Total curated `.pptx` presentation systems: 1060

## Primary Entry Points (Zero MCP Required)
- Agent Skill Instructions: /SKILL.md
- Technical README & Organic Layer Deconstruction: /README.md
- Machine-Readable JSON Catalog: GET /api/decks.json
- Native Editable OOXML Download: GET /pptx/<slug>.pptx
- Slide Keyframe PNG Previews: GET /previews/<slug>/slide_01.png
- Art Director Storyboard & Audit CLI: studio_engine/ai_slide_director.py

## CLI Tools for External AI Agents
1. Plan an organic DNA-preserving multi-stage storyboard before writing slide XML:
   python studio_engine/ai_slide_director.py storyboard --title "<Topic>" --category "Pitch" --industry "AI & DeepTech"
   (Pass --pptx <source.pptx> to extract real color & typography DNA from an existing deck.)
2. Lint and score any `.pptx` archive (0-100 DNA coherence & Morph scorecard):
   python studio_engine/ai_slide_director.py audit <path/to/deck.pptx>

## Core Presentation Rules
1. Fixed 16:9 canvas: 33.87 x 19.05 cm (12192000 x 6858000 EMU), outer safe margins >= 1.4 cm.
2. Preserve authentic DNA (color palette, monochrome character, typography) across every slide; never clash unrelated themes.
3. Deconstruct layers organically according to content complexity (no fixed 15-slide quota, no rigid 8-box stencil), pairing persistent shapes with `!!`-prefixed `<p:cNvPr name="!!sXX-layer-YY"/>` attributes and `<p159:morph option="byObject"/>` (`<p:fade/>` fallback).

## Categories
Pitch, Guideline, Report, Talks, Portfolio, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, Proposal, Other
